name: Cube wave
description: Concentric rings of rounded cubes spiralling away down a funnel, sized by a wave travelling outward through the rings. Built in polar space, so one distance function produces every ring at once and the count grows with radius on its own.

rings.description: Ring families evaluated per step. More fills the funnel deeper and costs proportionally.

size.description: Cube size at the crest of the wave.

wave.description: Rate the size wave travels outward through the rings.
